evidence.baseline: We have already explained, in the chapter on openness, why the great technology companies have not built this despite plainly seeing its value: built the ordinary way, closed and cloud-bound, it would be a surveillance instrument of such intimacy that no trustworthy company could deploy it and no clear-eyed person should accept it.
evidence.shipped: Large technology companies have explored wearables, assistants, health sensing, and conversational memory. The manuscript cannot claim to know why any company has or has not built this particular combination without evidence.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0024 bounding; recorded as a query, not a decision.
findings.diagnosis: Chapter seventeen's restored Panopticon section states the motive claim as the premise of the openness argument; this section's shipped text explicitly disclaimed the same premise. With one end restored and the other disclaiming it, the volume argued against itself. Under R-PAIRED-DELETION both ends must carry the same claim; restored, with the shipped motive bound already preserved in the panopticon record's F2 and the exposure recorded on CTD-0009.

findings.summary: The radioactive-intimacy inversion, the section's one idea, was deleted.

evidence.baseline: The thing that makes the system unbuildable for a closed, cloud-bound corporation (the radioactive intimacy of the fused signal) is exactly the thing that an open, sovereign, edge-run architecture renders safe. The same depth that is a prison in the cloud is a gift on hardware you control and in code you can audit.
evidence.shipped: An open, local architecture addresses some privacy concerns. It does not solve the others.

findings.diagnosis: The inversion (the disqualifier is the opening) is why the section exists and why the chapter is named for it. The shipped residue keeps the caution and loses the idea. The prison-and-gift pair also pairs to chapter seventeen's gift-or-prison turn, restored in this lane. Restored; the fence became parentheses.

evidence.baseline: Here, then, is the flywheel. ... The companion is the engine. The deeper coordination work is what the engine is for.
evidence.shipped: That is an opening for careful research and product design, not proof of a vacant billion-dollar market.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression; the shipped market bound preserved.
